title: The Ext equation on bundled derived endpoint data
statement: For xi:Ext²(S,H) and chosen derived endpoint/arrow data p:ExtDerivedPresentation(S,H), p.Presents(xi) means ExtArrowPresentation(xi,p.source,p.target,p.arrow). This is the same class-presentation equation with the category structures and endpoint types shared before specialization.
